title: Chapter 556
text:
The forked Mechanical Force lightning connected to a few Army Boxes. Han Xiao clenched his right fist and swung the lightning down.

The military box opened with a bang, and countless compressed orbs were shot towards Ashes like bullets, like thousands of arrows being shot at the same time.

Clack!

The dense sounds of mechanical components moving joined together, even suppressing all other sounds. All the compressed orbs opened up in midair, turning into countless mechanical objects that really blotted out the sky and covered the sun. They brazenly pounced down, as if there was a metal rainstorm.

Ashes's expression changed, and he hurriedly controlled the black tide to collide with them.

Bang! Bang! Bang!

The black tide was forcibly shattered, and the mechanical soldiers fell to the ground one after another. They were of different models and appearances, and some were tall while others were short. They covered the entire area, and Ember was surrounded by them all by himself. He was alone and helpless.

There were a total of four Army Boxes. Number 001 was [Mechanical Beast Guards Army]. Thousands of mechanical beasts circled around Ashes like wild beasts observing their prey.

Number 002 was [Assault Artillery Regiment]. This was a long-range unit that provided cover fire. They were located at the back of the formation, and they were all long-range attacking machines. There were rapid-fire cannons, large-caliber cannons, self-propelled cannons, small railguns, and so on. The cannons were aimed at Ashes from afar.

Number 003 was [G-1 Steel Army]. This was a mixed army, and they had the largest number of mechanical soldiers. They had a total of 6,400 mechanical soldiers.

Among them, there was an even larger assault unit. Their armor was extremely thick and reflected a cold metallic luster. They stood at the front of the formation, holding an alloy tower shield that was glowing with energy.

There was also a harassment unit formed by the fourth-generation tracked rangers, a rocket-type mechanical assault unit equipped with high-speed thrusters, and an aerial unit that floated in the sky and could launch laser attacks or set traps.

Lastly, there was [Oathkeeper Personal Guards] Number 101. Together with the 'Fighter' and 'Cannoneer', there were a total of eight Oathkeepers protecting him.

Han Xiao had four Mech Legions. Other than the Oathkeeper, which was an elite unit, the other three Mech Legions used regular models of machinery and used human wave tactics.

The numbering of the regular corps was' 0 ', while the numbering of the elite corps was' 1 '.

The construction of the Army Style required a lot of time, money, and energy. To build four Mech Legions, Han Xiao had spent a lot of money. Even with the help of the assembly line, it still took a lot of time to build the machines. The mechanical soldiers he had configured were all carefully selected blueprints. They had combat power and could be quickly replaced if they were lost.

In theory, as long as one had the money, they could build as many armies as they wanted, as long as the AI controlling the army could keep up with the calculation speed. If one AI was not enough, then they could build another one. With money, they could do whatever they wanted.

However, Han Xiao had only built four armies, which took him nearly three months. He had originally planned to expand his army after reaching A-Rank. That would be a huge leap forward, and his manufacturing speed would be greatly increased, saving him a lot of time. Moreover, the mechanical attributes he would build would also be stronger, and there would be more powerful blueprints.

This was the first time Han Xiao had mobilized the entire Mech Legion.

The Mech Legion surrounded Ashes, their alloy armor reflecting the sunlight.

Han Xiao fired a Void Spray at Ashes.

The muzzle of the gun pointed in the direction of the army!

Kaboom!

The next second, the Mech Legion pressed forward like a metal tide!

The cannon fire was almost endless. Every second, thousands of light cannons would hit Ember's Black Tide Barrier. The Diamond Barrier was constantly being shattered and reformed. Ember suddenly felt a great pressure and clenched his teeth.

Even if he had Calamity Grade resistance, if he was hit by so many attacks, he would definitely be seriously injured!

Ashes felt as if an entire division was surrounding him, and he was overwhelmed by the machines. He did not know what to do.

His face was filled with shock. Every time he fought with Black Star, the speed of his opponent's growth would make him subconsciously feel fear. The gap between them seemed to be shrinking, and he was being caught up.

"Can't I beat him?"

Ashes's eyes were instantly bloodshot, and he roared in anger.

Smoke-like carbon particles rose from all directions and merged into his Black Tide. The Black Tide continued to grow and soon formed a cloud of black particles that covered hundreds of meters. The cloud kept changing its shape, and the outer layer kept turning into diamond to block the attacks. At the same time, a few giant black snakes poked their heads out of the black cloud and passed through the mechanical army. They kept swallowing and destroying the mechanical soldiers, kicking up clouds of dust.

"Calamity Grades are indeed not easy to deal with." Han Xiao continued to release Mechanical Force, providing a large number of bonuses to the machines.

He was not worried about the energy consumption at all. As long as he charged into the black tide and took a few hits, his energy would more or less be fully recovered. This was how unbridled a perpetual motion machine was.

The Army Style used the human wave tactic, and it was even more perverse than the Summoning class. The Summoning class would at least consume energy, but the Army Style's machines were prepared in advance. Both had their pros and cons, and in terms of combat power, the Army Style had the advantage.

The Summoning class burned energy, while the Army Style burned money. Just like the legendary skill 'Desperate Gambit', money was equivalent to the combat power of a Mechanic.

The Army Style could crush opponents of the same level, and it could exhaust those of the higher levels. Ashes, a Calamity Grade Super, was in a passive position. In the past, when he was in Noriose, Han Xiao could only avoid direct battles. Now, he could fight head-on with Ashes and even suppress him. The change was obvious.

Even if Ashes could withstand it,

He would be able to resist the focus fire and slowly eat away at the Mech Legion. However, his energy was limited, and if he could continue to exhaust it, it would be hard to tell who would emerge victorious. This meant that the chances of Ashes losing were not low!

Calamity Grade Supers were basically undefeatable against Grade B Supers. There were very few Grade B Supers who could surpass the gap between them and defeat a Calamity Grade Super.

The battle between the two of them was reaching its climax. After the Mech Legion entered the battle, the commotion caused was like an earthquake, and it was difficult not to notice. The players far away in the base were shocked when they saw the battle between Han Xiao and Ashes.

Compared to the strength displayed by Black Star, his performance in dealing with the Mutation Source was like child's play!

Pork Bun's eyes lit up, and he fearlessly rushed to the front lines to record the battle.

Hella brought Aurora back to the protective shield of the base. She turned around to look at the shockingly large battlefield, and a look of worry flashed through her eyes. Han Xiao was right. She could not interfere in a battle of this level.

In the sky, Nagojin was leading his troops to fight against the Dark-star battleships that were attacking the Sanctuary. Herlous and the rest were following Han Xiao's orders and leading a portion of the players to reinforce the Six Nations.

Right at this moment, a new batch of Dark-star battleships appeared in the sky and rapidly approached. The number of battleships was many times that of the first batch.

The main force of Dark-star had arrived!

Everyone's faces changed.

The situation had become even worse!

…

As the two auras descended, Han Xiao's eyes flickered, and he ordered the Mech Legion to stop their attacks and pull apart the distance between them, protecting him in the center.

Ashes was panting slightly. He had only faced the Mech Legion Style for a short while, and he was already feeling exhausted. He realized that if he continued fighting, he would most likely die. His Esper Ability was suitable for killing carbon-based lifeforms, but it was not that effective against these alloy machines. If they were just ordinary machines, it would still be fine. However, these were all machines that had been enhanced by Black Star's Mechanical Force, and it was extremely tiring to fight them.

But at this time, Ashes smiled, containing great confidence — his reinforcements had arrived!

In the other two directions, Degulish and Terry each occupied a position, forming a triangle with Ashes and surrounding Han Xiao.

"Not bad, Ashes. He's being held back by you." Degulish nodded, his body surging with energy. He was a Pugilist.

Ashes looked at Han Xiao, took a deep breath, and joked, "My mission is not to kill you but to keep you here. The moment you fight, you'll fall into my trap. You didn't expect this, did you?"

Ashes was hoping that Han Xiao would panic or run away. However, Han Xiao did not panic, nor did he have any intention of running away. Instead, he assumed a battle stance.

Han Xiao also had the intention of holding back the enemy. At the same time, he did not want the enemy to discover that he had long known about the ambush. Thus, he went with the flow. In any case, his mechanical suit's helmet covered his face, and no one could see his expression.

Looking at the three of them, Han Xiaoxin began to plan.

"This ambush is directed at me. Three Calamity Grade Supers, and their killing intent is really firm. Luckily, I released Risda, or I would have a headache like Godora …"

"Right now, I have to do my best to hold back these three fellows so that they won't have the energy to deal with the others. That Pugilist gives me the most pressure, and he's probably stronger than the other two. I wonder if I can withstand the damage from the three of them … but it shouldn't be a problem for a short period of time!"

All sorts of thoughts flashed past his mind, and Han Xiao took a deep breath. He activated [Medium Cell Proliferation Control], expending a portion of his energy to recover his health.

"Only three? That's too little! "

Stubborn!

Not seeing the scene that he was looking forward to, Ashes gritted his teeth in anger.

Seeing that Han Xiao wanted to resist, Degulish sneered in his heart.

A Grade B Super was facing three Calamity Grade Supers, and he still wanted to resist?

Black Star was relying on his Mech Legion? Heh, did he think that he could stop three Grade A Supers just like that? It wouldn't take long to dismantle all of them, and it was even more impossible to stop them. As a Pugilist, he could directly charge through the Mech Legion and kill Black Star.

Overestimating himself!

Terry patted his chest, and a light combat suit appeared on his body. A few pieces of metal that were as soft as cloth popped out of his arms. He didn't know what material they were made of, but when he flicked them casually, the metal pieces suddenly extended dozens of meters and swept out like a whip. It was like a fairy scattering flowers. Highly concentrated energy was wrapped around it, and it had an extremely strong cutting power, instantly cutting more than a dozen machines around it into pieces.

This was a Mechanical Pugilist.

"I wonder how long the space disruption device will be able to stop Godora's reinforcements. Don't waste time and quickly get rid of him," Terry said.

The moment he said that.

Ashes, Degulish, and Terry charged into the Mech Legion from three different directions. Exploding with all their strength, the mechanical soldiers were sent flying one after another, shattering into parts. The three of them instantly cleared a path and headed straight for Han Xiao.

Three powerful auras assaulted his soul, and the Mechanical Force around Han Xiao's body pulsed non-stop.

His eyelids twitched, and his tone was firm.

"Come, let's have some fun!"

…
